annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Commission, Learning Corner (Directorate-General for Communication / DG Education)
key_provisions_or_claims: AI is already used in education, e.g. language learning and personalised teaching, but thorough impact assessment is lacking.
The guidelines give concrete examples of AI use in education and outline ethical requirements.
They present new competence needs and key concepts for the education sector.
Teachers are encouraged to share the guidelines with colleagues and parents.
annotation.summary_en: EU Learning Corner page presenting the European Commission's ethical guidelines on the use of AI and data in teaching and learning for educators. It describes the guidelines' content (examples, ethical requirements, new competences) and links to the PDF, but does not reproduce the text.
annotation.title_clean: Tekoälyn ja datan käyttö: eettiset ohjeet opettajille
annotation.title_en: Use of AI and data in teaching and learning: ethical guidelines for educators
